items.claim: Luciano is young, improving, and has very good striking and volume.
items.quote: Luciano, she's young, she's improving, she's obviously a very good striker, very good volume.

items.claim: Luciano will have a height and reach advantage in this fight.
items.quote: She's going to have a height advantage here, probably has a reach advantage as well.

items.claim: Luciano has shown she can mix in takedowns.
items.quote: she's shown that she can mix in some takedowns.

items.claim: Oban Elliott is on back-to-back losses coming from a shutout against Sung Young Cho and a submission loss to Jonathan Brookins.
items.quote: he got completely shut out against Sung Young Cho... and then he went out there against Jonathan Brookins and got submitted. So he's on back-to-back losses

items.claim: Michael Oliveira walks opponents down like Michael Myers and marches them forward.
items.quote: He he walks you down like Michael Myers. He's made out of iron. You know, if you hit him, he's not going to react at the slightest bit. He's going to walk forward. He's going to march you down

items.claim: Michael Oliveira has eight knockouts in nine fights.
items.quote: Nine fights, I believe eight knockouts.

items.claim: Nina Milosevic has good striking, fast, accurate hands, and some pop.
items.quote: She's good. She has good striking, fast, accurate hands. She has some pop on those hands as well.

items.claim: Nina Milosevic is a very good grappler, good wrestler, and opportunistic with submissions.
items.quote: She's a very good grappler, good wrestler, opportunistic submissions.

items.claim: Hailey Cowan is 7-5 and 0-3 in the UFC.
items.quote: She's seven and five. Uh she looks awful in there. I mean, this is I'm surprised she hasn't been cut yet, but you know, she will be cut after this fight. She's on a three-fight skin. She's 0 and 3 in the UFC.

items.claim: Hailey Cowan has four losses inside the distance, including three submissions and one knockout.
items.quote: Hailey Cowan four or five losses, four of those come inside the distance. She has three submission losses on her record and one knockout loss

items.claim: Denis Buzukja is not elite in striking, wrestling, jiu-jitsu, durability, or cardio, but is just okay everywhere.
items.quote: Is it his striking? Like, no, I don't He's not the best striker. It's like, he's not the best wrestler. Doesn't have the best jiu-jitsu. He's He's not the most durable guy in the world. He doesn't have the best cardio. Like, what is Like, what is Buzukja? Like, he's just He's He's one of these guys that's just like, okay everywhere.

items.claim: Bogdan Grad throws a lot of volume and is a BJJ black belt.
items.quote: Bogdan Grad, he's going to throw a lot of volume. I think he's much more dangerous wherever the fight goes. He's a BJJ black belt.

items.claim: Tofiq Musayev is 36 years old with 30 fights and has a lot of wear and tear.
items.quote: this guy says he's 36 years old. He's probably like closer to 40... this guy's also a a big giant cheater... this guy has 30 fights. A lot of wear and tear.

items.claim: Ludovit Klein has several previous submission wins, including guillotines, an armbar, and rear-naked chokes.
items.quote: he has like eight eight seven or eight submissions. He has like a lot of guillotines. He has like an armbar. A rear naked choke or two.
